conventions.c2w_storage: row-major 4x4; columns 0..2 are camera axes in world; column 3 is position
conventions.pixel_coordinates: integer (u,v) are pixel centres; top-left centre=(0,0)
conventions.vertical_fov: angle between top and bottom image edges, not between outermost pixel centres
conventions.crf_pixel_equivalence: CRF samples at (x+0.5,y+0.5) in image-edge coordinates; integer-centre OpenCV K above is equivalent
conventions.lens: pinhole, aperture=0, no distortion, global shutter
conventions.image_array: top-to-bottom rows; PFM file storage is bottom-to-top and must be flipped when decoded

split.method: contiguous azimuth blocks withheld across all elevations; not random adjacent-frame splitting
split.guard_gap: none; boundary neighbours can be 9 degrees apart
split.lighting_split: same view labels for every lighting group; all lights are provided, not a held-out-light benchmark
